summary: Sampling randomness. Google recommends keeping temperature at 1 for current Gemini reasoning models because lowering it can degrade reasoning and may cause looping. Lixpi fixes it at 1 and exposes thinkingLevel—not temperature—as the reasoning quality control.
combines: Google recommends `1` for the reviewed Gemini thinking models. Lowering it can degrade reasoning quality or cause repetitive and looping output.
It composes with `topP` and `topK`, but changing several sampling controls at once makes output behavior harder to predict.
Thinking level controls reasoning depth independently. Lixpi fixes temperature at `1` and exposes only the reviewed thinking-level choices.

usage.from: aiModelMetaInfo.defaultTemperature from the model record, falling back to 0.7
usage.what: Sampling randomness. Gated on inferenceCapabilities.supportsTemperature so models that reject the field never see it. One value for every request on a model; nothing per-conversation.

note: Fixed at Google's recommended value. Not user-configurable.
